name: SIGMA - SSH authorized_keys File Modified
description:
Detects auditd PATH records showing a write to an authorized_keys or authorized_keys2
file. Adding a public key there grants password-less SSH access that survives password
resets, so it is a favoured persistence mechanism (and privilege escalation when the
file belongs to root). The PARENT path record is filtered to avoid duplicates. Requires
audit watches on the relevant .ssh directories (see docs/lab-integration.md).
